_note: Hand-written registry of the 35 career domains. 'occupations' are EXACT O*NET 31.0 occupation titles used only to estimate where each domain sits on the interest map (scripts/build-domains.mjs resolves them and fails if a title is missing). Blurbs are our own wording. O*NET occupations are US occupations: they describe the kind of work, not Indian jobs, qualifications or pay.
